title: The Summer Solstice
synopsis: Learn about the different ways the summer solstice is celebrated in China.

fullText.simplified:
二十四节气之夏至

    夏至是二十四节气中最早被确定的一个节气，每年的夏至日是6月21日前后。这一天，北半球白天最长，黑夜最短，一年中最热的时候到了。
    在古时候的中国，夏至是一个很重要的节日。清朝之前，每到夏至，全国放假一天，大家都回家和亲人团聚，可见古人对夏至的重视。
    虽然夏至在今天的中国已不再是一个节日了，但各地依然保持着许多传统习俗。
    在北京，有“冬至馄饨夏至面”的说法。每年一到夏至，老北京人就开始大吃生菜、凉面、炸酱面。这些生冷的食物可以帮助人们在夏天降火开胃，促进食欲。当然也不能过于贪凉，以免损伤脾胃。
    在湖南，夏至当天早上起床，人们会煮一个鸡蛋，将它染红，之后用小网装上，再系在孩子的胸前，一直挂到下午再吃掉鸡蛋。俗话说：“夏至吃鸡蛋，石头能踩烂”，民间认为夏至吃鸡蛋可以补充体力，让人平安健康。
    在江苏，人们会在夏至日吃馄饨。当地方言中，馄饨是“安安稳稳”的意思。所以，人们在夏至吃馄饨是希望自己可以安稳度夏。吃过馄饨，长辈会为小孩子称体重，希望孩子体重增加，更健康。
    放眼世界，为了迎接夏至的到来，很多国家都有仲夏节的庆祝活动。在北欧，人们头戴花环，身穿盛装，载歌载舞，欢度仲夏之夜。
    夏至的来临，也意味着一年即将过半。对万物而言，这又是一个新的开始。愿你快乐轻松，清凉一夏！
fullText.traditional:
二十四節氣之夏至

    夏至是二十四節氣中最早被確定的一個節氣，每年的夏至日是6月21日前後。這一天，北半球白天最長，黑夜最短，一年中最熱的時候到了。
    在古時候的中國，夏至是一個很重要的節日。清朝之前，每到夏至，全國放假一天，大家都回家和親人團聚，可見古人對夏至的重視。
    雖然夏至在今天的中國已不再是一個節日了，但各地依然保持著許多傳統習俗。
    在北京，有“冬至餛飩夏至麵”的說法。每年一到夏至，老北京人就開始大吃生菜、涼麵、炸醬麵。這些生冷的食物可以幫助人們在夏天降火開胃，促進食慾。當然也不能過於貪涼，以免損傷脾胃。
    在湖南，夏至當天早上起床，人們會煮一個雞蛋，將它染紅，之後用小網裝上，再繫在孩子的胸前，一直掛到下午再吃掉雞蛋。俗話說：“夏至吃雞蛋，石頭能踩爛”，民間認為夏至吃雞蛋可以補充體力，讓人平安健康。
    在江蘇，人們會在夏至日吃餛飩。當地方言中，餛飩是“安安穩穩”的意思。所以，人們在夏至吃餛飩是希望自己可以安穩度夏。吃過餛飩，長輩會為小孩子稱體重，希望孩子體重增加，更健康。
    放眼世界，為了迎接夏至的到來，很多國家都有仲夏節的慶祝活動。在北歐，人們頭戴花環，身穿盛裝，載歌載舞，歡度仲夏之夜。
    夏至的來臨，也意味著一年即將過半。對萬物而言，這又是一個新的開始。願你快樂輕鬆，清涼一夏！

sentences.english: The Summer Solstice in the Twenty-Four Solar Terms

sentences.simplified: 夏至是二十四节气中最早被确定的一个节气，
sentences.traditional: 夏至是二十四節氣中最早被確定的一個節氣，

sentences.simplified: 每年的夏至日是6月21日前后。
sentences.traditional: 每年的夏至日是6月21日前後。
sentences.pinyin: měi nián de xià zhì rì shì 1 yuè 3 rì qián hòu
sentences.english: Of the twenty-four solar terms, the summer solstice was the first solar term to be determined.

sentences.simplified: 这一天，北半球白天最长，黑夜最短，
sentences.traditional: 這一天，北半球白天最長，黑夜最短，
sentences.pinyin: zhè yì tiān běi bàn qiú bái tiān zuì cháng hēi yè zuì duǎn
sentences.english: Every year the day of the summer solstice falls around June 21st.

sentences.simplified: 一年中最热的时候到了。
sentences.traditional: 一年中最熱的時候到了。
sentences.pinyin: yì nián zhōng zuì rè de shí hou dào le
sentences.english: On this day, the daytime is the longest and the nighttime the shortest in the in the northern hemisphere.
The hottest part of the year has arrived.

sentences.simplified: 在古时候的中国，夏至是一个很重要的节日。
sentences.traditional: 在古時候的中國，夏至是一個很重要的節日。
sentences.pinyin: zài gǔ shí hou de zhōng guó xià zhì shì yí ge hěn zhòng yào de jié rì

sentences.simplified: 清朝之前，每到夏至，全国放假一天，大家都回家和亲人团聚，
sentences.traditional: 清朝之前，每到夏至，全國放假一天，大家都回家和親人團聚，
sentences.pinyin: qīng cháo zhī qián měi dào xià zhì quán guó fàng jià yì tiān dà jiā dōu huí jiā hé qīn rén tuán jù
sentences.english: In ancient China, the summer solstice was a very important holiday.

sentences.simplified: 可见古人对夏至的重视。
sentences.traditional: 可見古人對夏至的重視。
sentences.pinyin: kě jiàn gǔ rén duì xià zhì de zhòng shì
sentences.english: Prior to the Qing Dynasty, the entire nation got a day off every summer solstice and everyone could reunite with family.
It is evident that the ancient people placed a great importance on the summer solstice.

sentences.simplified: 虽然夏至在今天的中国已不再是一个节日了，
sentences.traditional: 雖然夏至在今天的中國已不再是一個節日了，
sentences.pinyin: suī rán xià zhì zài jīn tiān de zhōng guó yǐ bú zài shì yí ge jié rì le

sentences.simplified: 但各地依然保持着许多传统习俗。
sentences.traditional: 但各地依然保持著許多傳統習俗。
sentences.pinyin: dàn gè dì yī rán bǎo chí zhe xǔ duō chuán tǒng xí sú
sentences.english: Though the summer solstice is no longer a holiday in today’s China, ..
.. many of these traditions have been retained in different places in the country.

sentences.simplified: 在北京，有“冬至馄饨夏至面”的说法。
sentences.traditional: 在北京，有“冬至餛飩夏至麵”的說法。
sentences.pinyin: zài běi jīng yǒu dōng zhì hún tun xià zhì miàn de shuō fǎ

sentences.simplified: 每年一到夏至，
sentences.traditional: 每年一到夏至，
sentences.pinyin: měi nián yí dào xià zhì
sentences.english: In Beijing there is a saying, “Wonton for the winter solstice, noodles for the summer solstice.”

sentences.simplified: 老北京人就开始大吃生菜、凉面、炸酱面。
sentences.traditional: 老北京人就開始大吃生菜、涼麵、炸醬麵。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo běi jīng rén jiù kāi shǐ dà chī shēng cài liáng miàn zhá jiàng miàn
sentences.english: Every year when the summer solstice arrives, ..

sentences.simplified: 这些生冷的食物可以帮助人们在夏天降火开胃，促进食欲。
sentences.traditional: 這些生冷的食物可以幫助人們在夏天降火開胃，促進食慾。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē shēng lěng de shí wù kě yǐ bāng zhù rén men zài xià tiān jiàng huǒ kāi wèi cù jìn shí yù
sentences.english: .. natives of Beijing will start to eat a lot of lettuce, cold noodles, and soybean paste noodles.

sentences.simplified: 当然也不能过于贪凉，以免损伤脾胃。
sentences.traditional: 當然也不能過於貪涼，以免損傷脾胃。
sentences.pinyin: dāng rán yě bù néng guò yú tān liáng yǐ miǎn sǔn shāng pí wèi
sentences.english: These raw and cold foods can help people decrease their internal heat and increase their appetite during the summer.
Of course, one should not covet cold foods too much to avoid damaging the spleen and stomach.

sentences.simplified: 在湖南，夏至当天早上起床，
sentences.traditional: 在湖南，夏至當天早上起床，
sentences.pinyin: zài hú nán xià zhì dāng tiān zǎo shang qǐ chuáng

sentences.simplified: 人们会煮一个鸡蛋，将它染红，之后用小网装上，
sentences.traditional: 人們會煮一個雞蛋，將它染紅，之後用小網裝上，
sentences.pinyin: rén men huì zhǔ yí ge jī dàn jiāng tā rǎn hóng zhī hòu yòng xiǎo wǎng zhuāng shàng
sentences.english: In Hunan Province, people wake up early on the day of the summer solstice.

sentences.simplified: 再系在孩子的胸前，
sentences.traditional: 再繫在孩子的胸前，
sentences.pinyin: zài jì zài hái zi de xiōng qián
sentences.english: They will boil an egg, dye it red, and put it in a small net.

sentences.simplified: 一直挂到下午再吃掉鸡蛋。
sentences.traditional: 一直掛到下午再吃掉雞蛋。
sentences.pinyin: yì zhí guà dào xià wǔ zài chī diào jī dàn
sentences.english: The egg is then tied in front of a child’s chest, ..

sentences.simplified: 俗话说：
sentences.traditional: 俗話說：
sentences.pinyin: sú huà shuō
sentences.english: .. and hangs there until the afternoon when the child eats the egg.

sentences.simplified: “夏至吃鸡蛋，石头能踩烂”，
sentences.traditional: “夏至吃雞蛋，石頭能踩爛”，
sentences.pinyin: xià zhì chī jī dàn shí tou néng cǎi làn
sentences.english: As the saying goes, ..

sentences.simplified: 民间认为夏至吃鸡蛋可以补充体力，让人平安健康。
sentences.traditional: 民間認為夏至吃雞蛋可以補充體力，讓人平安健康。
sentences.pinyin: mín jiān rèn wéi xià zhì chī jī dàn kě yǐ bǔ chōng tǐ lì ràng rén píng ān jiàn kāng
sentences.english: “If you eat an egg on the summer solstice, the rock under your feat will be flattened.”
People believe that eating eggs during the summer solstice can increase strength and keep them safe and healthy.

sentences.simplified: 在江苏，人们会在夏至日吃馄饨。
sentences.traditional: 在江蘇，人們會在夏至日吃餛飩。
sentences.pinyin: zài jiāng sū rén men huì zài xià zhì rì chī hún tun

sentences.simplified: 当地方言中，馄饨是“安安稳稳”的意思。
sentences.traditional: 當地方言中，餛飩是“安安穩穩”的意思。
sentences.pinyin: dāng dì fāng yán zhōng hún tun shì ān ān wěn wěn de yì si
sentences.english: In Jiangsu Province, people will eat wontons on the day of the summer solstice.

sentences.simplified: 所以，人们在夏至吃馄饨是希望自己可以安稳度夏。
sentences.traditional: 所以，人們在夏至吃餛飩是希望自己可以安穩度夏。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ rén men zài xià zhì chī hún tun shì xī wàng zì jǐ kě yǐ ān wěn dù xià
sentences.english: In the local dialect, wonton means ”safe and sound”.

sentences.simplified: 吃过馄饨，长辈会为小孩子称体重，
sentences.traditional: 吃過餛飩，長輩會為小孩子稱體重，
sentences.pinyin: chī guò hún tun zhǎng bèi huì wèi xiǎo hái zi chēng tǐ zhòng
sentences.english: So, people eat wontons during the summer solstice because they hope to go have a peaceful summer.

sentences.simplified: 希望孩子体重增加，更健康。
sentences.traditional: 希望孩子體重增加，更健康。
sentences.pinyin: xī wàng hái zi tǐ zhòng zēng jiā gèng jiàn kāng
sentences.english: After eating wontons, the older generation will measure the weight of children ..
.. in the hope that they can put on weight and become more healthy.

sentences.simplified: 放眼世界，为了迎接夏至的到来，
sentences.traditional: 放眼世界，為了迎接夏至的到來，
sentences.pinyin: fàng yǎn shì jiè wèi le yíng jiē xià zhì de dào lái

sentences.simplified: 很多国家都有仲夏节的庆祝活动。
sentences.traditional: 很多國家都有仲夏節的慶祝活動。
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō guó jiā dōu yǒu zhòng xià jié de qìng zhù huó dòng
sentences.english: Looking at the rest of the world, in order to welcome the coming of the summer solstice, ..

sentences.simplified: 在北欧，人们头戴花环，
sentences.traditional: 在北歐，人們頭戴花環，
sentences.pinyin: zài běi ōu rén men tóu dài huā huán
sentences.english: .. many countries have midsummer celebrations.

sentences.simplified: 身穿盛装，载歌载舞，欢度仲夏之夜。
sentences.traditional: 身穿盛裝，載歌載舞，歡度仲夏之夜。
sentences.pinyin: shēn chuān shèng zhuāng zài gē zài wǔ huān dù zhòng xià zhī yè
sentences.english: In Northern Europe, people wear floral crowns, ..
.. dress the part, sing and dance, joyously spending the midsummer night.

sentences.simplified: 夏至的来临，也意味着一年即将过半。
sentences.traditional: 夏至的來臨，也意味著一年即將過半。
sentences.pinyin: xià zhì de lái lín yě yì wèi zhe yì nián jí jiāng guò bàn

sentences.simplified: 对万物而言，这又是一个新的开始。
sentences.traditional: 對萬物而言，這又是一個新的開始。
sentences.pinyin: duì wàn wù ér yán zhè yòu shì yí ge xīn de kāi shǐ
sentences.english: The coming of the summer solstice also signifies that the year is nearly halfway over.

sentences.simplified: 愿你快乐轻松，清凉一夏！
sentences.traditional: 願你快樂輕鬆，清涼一夏！
sentences.pinyin: yuàn nǐ kuài lè qīng sōng qīng liáng yí xià
sentences.english: For all living things, this is another new start.
Wishing you a happy, relaxing, and refreshing summer!

raw.synopsis: Learn about the different ways the summer solstice is celebrated in China.
sentence_translations: The Summer Solstice in the Twenty-Four Solar Terms
Of the twenty-four solar terms, the summer solstice was the first solar term to be determined.
Every year the day of the summer solstice falls around June 21st.
On this day, the daytime is the longest and the nighttime the shortest in the in the northern hemisphere.
The hottest part of the year has arrived.
In ancient China, the summer solstice was a very important holiday.
Prior to the Qing Dynasty, the entire nation got a day off every summer solstice and everyone could reunite with family.
It is evident that the ancient people placed a great importance on the summer solstice.
Though the summer solstice is no longer a holiday in today’s China, ..
.. many of these traditions have been retained in different places in the country.
In Beijing there is a saying, “Wonton for the winter solstice, noodles for the summer solstice.”
Every year when the summer solstice arrives, ..
.. natives of Beijing will start to eat a lot of lettuce, cold noodles, and soybean paste noodles.
These raw and cold foods can help people decrease their internal heat and increase their appetite during the summer.
Of course, one should not covet cold foods too much to avoid damaging the spleen and stomach.
In Hunan Province, people wake up early on the day of the summer solstice.
They will boil an egg, dye it red, and put it in a small net.
The egg is then tied in front of a child’s chest, ..
.. and hangs there until the afternoon when the child eats the egg.
As the saying goes, ..
“If you eat an egg on the summer solstice, the rock under your feat will be flattened.”
People believe that eating eggs during the summer solstice can increase strength and keep them safe and healthy.
In Jiangsu Province, people will eat wontons on the day of the summer solstice.
In the local dialect, wonton means ”safe and sound”.
So, people eat wontons during the summer solstice because they hope to go have a peaceful summer.
After eating wontons, the older generation will measure the weight of children ..
.. in the hope that they can put on weight and become more healthy.
Looking at the rest of the world, in order to welcome the coming of the summer solstice, ..
.. many countries have midsummer celebrations.
In Northern Europe, people wear floral crowns, ..
.. dress the part, sing and dance, joyously spending the midsummer night.
The coming of the summer solstice also signifies that the year is nearly halfway over.
For all living things, this is another new start.
Wishing you a happy, relaxing, and refreshing summer!
